name: Naive Voxel Ray Traversal
definition: A naive method for voxel ray traversal that steps forward in small delta t multiples of the direction, checking for a solid voxel at each step.
summary: Naive Voxel Ray Traversal is a brute-force rendering method that steps a ray forward in fixed increments to check for occupied voxels, differing from precise algorithms by using constant step sizes that simplify implementation but cause aliasing and missed voxels.
